Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a side-impact collision at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling through
the interseciton when the front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported
shoulder pain, and the nature of the impact is consistent with that complaint. A Passenger was also seated in Driver
1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and the parties on scene confirmed that Passenger's presence at the time
of the crash. Scene photographs show the damage is largely consistent with the described impact, and they
document the positions of both vehicles. A few older scratches on the side panels may predate this collision and were
noted but not attributed to it. No independent witnesses came forward. Driver 1 identified the driver as a household
member who lives with the policyholder. Officers did not observe any traffic signal violations by either driver and
issued no citations at the scene. Further review of the photographs and statements is recommended.
</page>
